test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can rectify the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to rectify it, select ‘no rectification needed’.

The conductor said that it was the __worse__ quake he ever knew.
solution:
The correct answer is: **worst**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word "worse" is incorrect when comparing it to past experiences of the conductor.
 
• Instead, the superlative form "worst" should be used to indicate that this earthquake was the most severe one the conductor had ever experienced.
 
• Superlative adjectives are used to describe an object which is at the upper or lower limit of a quality (e.g., the tallest, the smallest, the fastest, the highest).
 
• The sentence should read: "*The conductor said that it was the worst quake he ever knew.*"

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *The conductor said that it was the worst quake he ever knew.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When comparing two objects, use the comparative form of the adjective (e.g., better, worse).
 
• When comparing more than two objects, use the superlative form of the adjective (e.g., best, worst).
 
• Examples:
 
 
• *This is the best book I have ever read.*
 
• *Out of the three runners, she is the fastest.*
